description_nl: seconds_per_minute and stills_per_minute: the shape of 'one minute of video' the quote is built on. kinds: which kinds are quoted and in what order. video_line / image_line / text_line: the sentences. with_markup / at_cost: which of the two follows them. disclaimer: the sentence that says this is an estimate and why it moves - it is never dropped. text_words and words_per_1k_tokens turn a token price into a price per so many words. decimals_extra: places shown beyond the currency's own, because a rate per still is far smaller than a price.
